name: Altar Of Incense
overview: The Altar of Incense, crafted from shittim wood and overlaid with pure gold, was a sacred fixture placed before the veil in the outer sanctuary, symbolizing the prayers of God's people ascending to Him. Its precise dimensions and design, including a golden crown and rings for staves, highlight its holy and anointed nature. This altar was intimately connected to the presence of God, positioned before the mercy seat where God promised to meet with His people, emphasizing the necessity of pure, acceptable worship without unauthorized offerings.
